question: Which chemical element of the halogen group is a light greenish-yellow highly toxic gas with atomic number 17?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chlorine**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Chlorine**

 
 
• **Chlorine is a greenish-yellow **vaporous component. Its nuclear number is 17, and is one of the class called incandescent light in the occasional table.
 
• This tertiary tone is contained unequivocally half green and half yellow.<
